units.source_text: 傍晚烧好热水之前，怎么安排这段空闲的时间才好呢？

en.t: How should I spend this free time before the hot water is ready in the evening?

units.source_text: 再加上十月初，房间里还没生火盆，我以前遐想过，在我提出“咱们结婚吧”的时候，我和道子之间是放着火盆的。

en.t: Besides, it was early October and there was still no brazier lit in the room. I had once imagined that when I said, "Let's get married," there would be a brazier placed between Michiko and me.
